description: For work authorization, this log form records authorized task boundary, inclusions, exclusions, budget code, schedule dates, quality hold points, and interfaces. Its supporting evidence includes approved drawings, permit status, readiness inspection, coordination record, and required training evidence.

blocks.guidance: Link this work authorization record to its evidence.

blocks.guidance: Capture contract package, work area, responsible crew, predecessor completion, permits, submittals, and access window for this work authorization.
